fields.question: On PDF page 566, Table 3.6.2.0(b1) header: the specification(s) listed for 6061 aluminum alloy sheet. Report exactly as printed.

On PDF page 566, Table 3.6.2.0(b1): the FIRST (leftmost) thickness range column, in inches, under temper T6 (or T6 and T62) whose Basis row prints A and B (not S). Report the range exactly as printed.
On PDF page 566, Table 3.6.2.0(b1): Ftu, LT direction, A basis, for T6 sheet in that same column. Number as printed.
On PDF page 566, Table 3.6.2.0(b1): Fty, LT direction, A basis, for T6 sheet in that same column. Number as printed.
On PDF page 566, Table 3.6.2.0(b1): Fbru for e/D = 2.0, A basis, for T6 sheet in that same column. Number as printed. If no A/B split is printed for Fbru, report the single printed value.
On PDF page 566, Table 3.6.2.0(b1): the tension modulus of elasticity E, in 10^3 ksi, from the physical-properties block. Number as printed.
On PDF page 566, Table 3.6.2.0(b1): the elongation (e, percent) value printed for T6 sheet in that same column, LT direction if directions are printed. Number as printed.
On PDF page 566, Table 3.6.2.0(b1): the density (omega, lb/in.3) printed in the physical-properties block. Number as printed.
